binary_format: u32le metadata length+JSON; u32 qmapbytes+qmap; u32 hudbytes+encodedHUD; fixedcaps256/65536 x3planes: u32chunkcount; each u32blocks/u32packetbytes/actualAB38packet.
semantics: All visible tiles are encoded for keys and deltas, including zero-coefficient tiles. Hidden CONST tiles are omitted. Residual order is ascending canonical tile within each plane; DC predictor resets per residual tile (bw1).
scope: Components only, no frame-envelope/transport bytes or physical timing claim.
